title: The Quest to Close the Limbo Rift

scenes.caption: Izzy suggests that the brave adventurers will need superhero costumes and helmets to face the scary realm of Limbo.

quote.speaker: Izzy
quote.text: They just get, they just need superhero costumes.

scenes.caption: Izzy recommends bringing potions, magic spells, and flashlights to help guide the adventurers along the way.

quote.speaker: Izzy
quote.text: How about potions and magic spells and some flashlights to guide them the way there?

scenes.caption: Izzy insists that the mission should wait until morning when someone can guide them.

quote.speaker: Izzy
quote.text: Okay. But maybe they should do it in the morning because they might need somebody to guide them. So we should do it in the morning.

scenes.caption: Izzy confidently declares that she can be brave, and Silver the cat will join her on the journey.

quote.speaker: Izzy
quote.text: Okay, but I can do it. I can be brave.
